newsitem.title: UK: LME ZINC SPREAD ENDS KERB SHARPLY WIDER.
newsitem.headline: LME ZINC SPREAD ENDS KERB SHARPLY WIDER.

text.p: ZINC - Spread zooms out, ends at $150/$160 backwardation from $100 on Thursday. Three months finishes little changed.
ALUMINIUM - Finishes with pared losses, stabilises at $1,750. Cash/threes at $15/$20 backwardation.
COPPER - Off lows, but under $2,300. NICKEL - Weaker at $7,100.
TIN - Quiet, touch softer. LEAD - Slightly easier.
